Interface Styleable

All Known Implementing Classes:
BarChartElement, CalendarElement, CanvasElement, ChartElement, Column, ColumnsElement, Component, ContainerElement, DialogElement, DockElement, DualSparklineElement, ElementRegistry.ElementInfo, FlowElement, FormElement, FormFieldElement, GaugeElement, GenericWidgetElement, GridElement, InlineScopeElement, LineGaugeElement, ListElement, MarkdownElement, MarkupTextAreaElement, MarkupTextElement, Panel, RichTextAreaElement, RichTextElement, Row, ScrollableElement, ScrollbarElement, SparklineElement, SpinnerElement, StackElement, StyledElement, StyledSpan, TableElement, TabsElement, TextAreaElement, TextElement, TextInputElement, TreeElement, WaveTextElement
public interface Styleable
Interface for elements that can be styled via CSS.

Elements implementing this interface can be targeted by CSS selectors and have CSS rules applied to them during rendering.

  • Method Details

    • styleType

      default String styleType()
      Returns the style type name used for type selectors.

      For example, a Panel element would return "Panel" to match the CSS selector Panel { ... }.

      Returns:
      the style type name (never null)

    • cssId

      Optional<String> cssId()
      Returns the element ID for ID selectors.

      For example, an element with ID "sidebar" would be matched by the CSS selector #sidebar { ... }.

      Returns:
      the element ID, or empty if not set

    • cssClasses

      Set<String> cssClasses()
      Returns the CSS classes assigned to this element.

      For example, an element with class "primary" would be matched by the CSS selector .primary { ... }.

      Returns:
      an unmodifiable set of CSS class names (never null, may be empty)

    • cssParent

      Optional<Styleable> cssParent()
      Returns the parent element in the style hierarchy.

      Used for descendant and child combinator selectors like Panel Button { ... } or Panel > Button { ... }.

      Returns:
      the parent element, or empty if this is a root element

    • styleAttributes

      default Map<String,String> styleAttributes()
      Returns the style attributes for attribute selector matching.

      Attribute selectors like Panel[title="Test"] match elements based on their style attributes. This method returns a map of attribute names to their values.

      Common attributes include:

      • title - the element's title
      • label - the element's label
      • placeholder - the element's placeholder text
      Returns:
      an unmodifiable map of attribute names to values (never null, may be empty)

    • styleTypesOf

      static List<String> styleTypesOf(Styleable element)
      Builds the list of style types for an element, ordered by precedence.

      The list contains the element's type and all parent types in the class hierarchy that implement Styleable. Types are ordered with lower precedence first (parent types) and higher precedence last (most specific type).

      For example, if MyPanel extends Panel and both implement Styleable, calling styleTypes(myPanel) returns ["Panel", "MyPanel"].

      Parameters:
      element - the element to get style types for
      Returns:
      an ordered list of style type names
